name: Jörgen Warborn - Article 4 – alinéa 1 – point 2; Article 3 – paragraphe 1 – point n - Am 82
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
part_text: (a) point (n) is replaced by the following: ‘(n) ‘stakeholders’ means the company’s employees, the employees of its subsidiaries and of its business partners, and their trade unions and workers’ representatives, and individuals or communities whose rights or interests are or could be directly affected by the adverse impacts on human rights and the environment that stem from the products, services and operations of the company, its subsidiaries and its business partners and the legitimate representatives of those individuals or communities;’;
